VIII.}}</noinclude>same day there vvas made a great persecution in the Church, vvhich vvas at Hierusalem, and al vvere dispersed through the countries of Ievvrie and Samaria, sauing the Apostles. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=2}}† And {{sup|‖}} deuout men {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''c curauerunt συνεκόμισαν''}}∷ tooke order for Steuens funeral, and made great mourning vpon him. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=3}}† But Saul {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Act. 22, 4.''}}* vvasted the Church: entring in from house to house, and dravving men and vvomen, deliuered them into prison.

{{verse|chapter=8|verse=4}}† They therfore that vvere dispersed, passed through, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ This persecution vvrought much good, being an occasion that the dispersed preached Christ in diuers Coũtries vvhere they came.}}∷ euangelizing the vvord.

{{verse|chapter=8|verse=5}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Epistle vpõ Thursday in vvhitsunvveeke.}}And Philippe descending into the citie of Samaria, preached {{sc|Christ}} vnto them. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=6}}† And the multitudes vvere attent to those things vvhich vvere said of Philippe, vvith one accord hearing, and seing the signes that he did. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=7}}† For many of them that had vncleane spirits, crying vvith a loud voice, vvent out. And many sicke of the palsey and lame vvere cured. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=8}}† There vvas made therfore great ioy in that citie.⊣ {{verse|chapter=8|verse=9}}† And a certaine man named Simon, vvho before had been in that citie a Magician, seducing the nation of Samaria, saying him self to be some great one: {{verse|chapter=8|verse=10}}† vnto vvhom al harkened from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the povver of God, that is called great. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=11}}† And they vvere attent vpon him, because a long time he had bewitched them vvith his magical practises. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=12}}† But vvhen they had beleeued Philippe euangelizing of the kingdom of God, and of the name of {{sc|Iesvs Christ}}, they vvere baptized, men and vvomen. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=13}}† Then Simon also him self beleeued: and being baptized, he cleaued to Philippe. Seing also signes and very great miracles to be done, he vvas astonied vvith admiration.<noinclude>{{rh|||And}}</noinclude>
